engine.notes: Two training theaters carry the city. The Pittsburgh Improv in Homestead is a stand-up franchise despite the name, the Thursday improv jam at Brillobox exists only on Facebook, and unplannedcomedy.com, once Unplanned Comedy Warehouse, now serves a gambling page.

entries.name: Arcade Comedy Theater
entries.summary: Downtown Pittsburgh's nonprofit comedy theater since 2013: improv, stand-up and sketch every Friday and Saturday, Sunday jams, and an academy running Improv 101 through 401 in eight-week sessions that each end in a show.
entries.schedule: Shows Fri-Sat, jams Sundays; eight-week classes $225-$300, Session 6 starts Oct 19-29, 2026
signals: Every class ends with a show
entries.reasons: Thirteen years in its own downtown theater, a four-level academy with dated sessions and class shows, house teams, weekend shows and Sunday jams, all on a site dated to the week.

entries.name: Steel City Improv Theater
entries.summary: Shadyside's improv theater since 2010, with its own stage at 5950 Ellsworth Ave, a levelled adult improv program taught by a faculty of seventeen, try-it-out workshops for newcomers and a shows-and-events calendar.
entries.schedule: All classes registering for fall 2026; try-it-out workshops for adults, kids and teens
signals: Kids and teens classes coming soon
entries.reasons: Sixteen years in its own Shadyside theater and a levelled program with a large faculty earn a strong base, but the class and show pages render only in the browser, so levels, prices and show nights could not be read.
